Rina: Kicking off a short follow-up from INC-2026-42. Goal: close remediation gaps for rollouts and make a light-weight containment playbook. Keep items runnable within two sprints.
Marco: I can take ownership of the containment playbook. We should include a quick rollback CLI, circuit-breaker steps, and communication templates.
Tess: I'll prototype the auto-rollback policy but keep it opt-in. Thoughts: min_samples 250, absolute uplift 1.2%, and require two consecutive windows of 60s.
Jules: SRE input: add tenant caps so a single tenant can't hit >10% of traffic during canary. Also require resource pinning for safe variants.
oncall-bot: Alert muted for scheduled drill 2026-08-20 14:00
Rina: Proposed quick wins: 1) add allowlist + per-deployment toggle, 2) dashboard tile for canary error uplifts, 3) rollback CLI + idempotency test, 4) containment drill runbook.
Marco: I'll assemble the runbook and templates. Expect draft in 4d.
Tess: Auto-rollback PoC in 10d. I'll open PR with flag `auto_rollback: {enabled:false, allowlist:[]}` and the statistical check.
Jules: I'll add quota for concurrent rollbacks and a 10m cooldown. Also add an emergency redirect to safe-model variant.
Rina: Keep private deployments default-off and require compliance signoff. We'll track actions in the incident tracker: https://go/actions/pm/INC-2026-42.
Tess: Noted. Adding unit tests for false-positive rate with synthetic load.
Marco: I'll schedule the drill and invite oncall + product.
Rina: Thanks team. We'll review progress in next postmortem sync.
